title: Final Energy Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The ground state energy E_0 must be calculated correctly as -6.8 eV.

title: Final Radius Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The Bohr radius a_0 must be calculated correctly as 1.05 x 10^-8 cm.

title: Reduced Mass Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The reduced mass of positronium must be derived correctly as m = m_e/2.

title: Degeneracy Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The degeneracy of the positronium ground state must be stated correctly as 4 with appropriate spin states.

title: Energy Release Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The energy released during annihilation must be calculated correctly as 1.02 MeV.

title: Angular Momentum Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The explanation of angular momentum released must be clear, including the case for S = 0 and S = hbar.

title: Photon Conservation Argument
description: Important Criteria: The argument for the necessity of at least two photons must be logically sound and clearly articulated.

title: Common Calculation Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign mistakes or incorrect factors in the energy or radius calculations will incur a penalty.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any unit mistakes in the final answers will incur a penalty.
